verdict.rationale: Riveter's core enrichment primitive works in bulk: it takes rows of input data and fills new columns with AI and web tools, accepts up to 10,000 rows per /enrich request, and can expand a list (every dental practice, then every dentist in each) in a single request. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of large batch runs, and documentation of bulk management operations (bulk update, delete or rerun) beyond enrichment and dataset generation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: An enrichment takes rows of input data and fills in new columns using AI, web searches, web scrapes, and other tools.
up to 10,000 rows per `/enrich` request with `enrichment_id`
It can find every dental practice in a city, then pull every dentist from each one, in a single request.
